description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Server class, an implementation of an XML-RPC server within the Zend Framework. It manages registration of functions and classes, handles requests, and manages system methods for XML-RPC communication.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server
classes.description: An implementation of an XML-RPC server that manages method registration, request handling, and system method setup within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the server and registers system methods.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Proxies method calls to the internal system object.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Attaches a callback function or functions as XML-RPC methods, with optional namespace prefix.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Attaches class methods as XML-RPC handlers, with optional namespace and arguments.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Creates a fault response, either from an exception or message.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an XML-RPC request and returns a response or fault.

methods.name: loadFunctions
methods.description: Loads methods from a given definition, typically used with cached definitions.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets character encoding for the server.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves current character encoding.

methods.name: setPersistence
methods.description: Placeholder for setting persistence; no operation.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the request object, validating its class.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current request object.

methods.name: setResponseClass
methods.description: Sets the class used for responses, validating it.

methods.name: getResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the current response class.

methods.name: getDispatchTable
methods.description: Returns the dispatch table of methods.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of registered functions.

methods.name: getSystem
methods.description: Returns the system object managing system methods.

methods.name: sendArgumentsToAllMethods
methods.description: Gets or sets whether arguments are sent to all methods.

methods.name: _fixType
methods.description: Maps PHP types to XML-RPC types.

methods.name: _handle
methods.description: Performs the actual work of handling an XML-RPC request.

methods.name: _registerSystemMethods
methods.description: Registers system methods with the server.
